instruction: Remove the star from all emails in the Bills folder

rules.sql: select sum(1) = 0 from messageAttributes where attributeID = 58 and value = 1 and messageID in (select id from messages where folderID = 13);

metadata.explanation: Task requires removing stars from all emails in Bills folder (folderID=13). The evaluator checks that NO messages in Bills have attributeID=58 (star) set to value=1. SQL returns 1 (true) if count is 0. Verified from database: Bills has 2 emails.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly fetches the Thunderbird global messages database file
SQL query logic correctly checks for star attribute (attributeID=58) with value=1 in Bills folder (folderID=13)
Query returns 1 (true) when count is 0, meaning all stars have been removed, which matches the instruction requirement
Postconfig appropriately closes Thunderbird to ensure database is saved and not locked before verification
Complete coverage: evaluator verifies that ALL emails in Bills folder have no stars, not just some
Data flow is semantically correct: close app → fetch database → run SQL → return pass/fail based on star count
